Visible_Nail_Signs: Smooth, uniform nail plate, healthy pink nail bed, normal thickness and curvature, no discoloration or ridging

Key_Symptoms: Fatigue, brittle nails, pale skin, cold intolerance
Visible_Nail_Signs: Koilonychia (spoon-shaped nails with concave upward-curving surface), thin and brittle nail plate
Common_Systemic_Symptoms: Fatigue, pallor, dizziness, hair thinning, restless legs, shortness of breath on exertion
Risk_Factors: Heavy menstrual bleeding, poor dietary iron intake, pregnancy, chronic blood loss, GI disorders

Key_Symptoms: Numbness/tingling in extremities, fatigue, memory problems, sore tongue
Visible_Nail_Signs: Melanonychia (longitudinal brown/black pigmented bands on nail plate), possible nail bed pallor
Common_Systemic_Symptoms: Megaloblastic anemia, peripheral neuropathy, glossitis, pale skin, memory issues
Risk_Factors: Vegan/vegetarian diet, pernicious anemia, gastric bypass surgery, elderly age, metformin use, malabsorption

Key_Symptoms: Easy bruising, bleeding gums, joint pain, slow wound healing
Visible_Nail_Signs: Periungual (splinter-like) hemorrhages around and under the nail fold, petechiae near cuticle
Common_Systemic_Symptoms: Scurvy symptoms: fatigue, swollen/bleeding gums, poor wound healing, corkscrew body hair
Risk_Factors: Severe dietary restriction, poor fruit/vegetable intake, alcoholism, smoking, malabsorption

Key_Symptoms: Abnormal nail shape/texture, delayed wound healing, altered taste, skin lesions
Visible_Nail_Signs: Nail dystrophy (distorted/malformed nail plate growth), brittle and discolored nails
Common_Systemic_Symptoms: Acrodermatitis enteropathica-like rash, diarrhea, impaired immunity, poor appetite, hair loss
Risk_Factors: Malabsorption syndromes, vegetarian/vegan diet, chronic diarrhea, alcoholism, pregnancy

Key_Symptoms: Rough/ridged nail texture, delayed wound healing, altered taste
Visible_Nail_Signs: Transverse or longitudinal ridging of nail plate, rough nail surface texture
Common_Systemic_Symptoms: Skin lesions, diarrhea, poor appetite, impaired immunity, hair thinning
Risk_Factors: Malabsorption syndromes, low dietary zinc intake, chronic illness, excessive sweating

Key_Symptoms: Redness and swelling around nail fold, tenderness, occasional discharge
Visible_Nail_Signs: Inflamed, swollen, tender skin surrounding nail plate without clear infectious source, chronic low-grade paronychia
Common_Systemic_Symptoms: Skin lesions elsewhere, poor wound healing, diarrhea, impaired immunity
Risk_Factors: Chronic zinc deficiency, malabsorption, frequent hand-in-water occupations compounding the deficiency effect

Key_Symptoms: Thin, fragile nails, fatigue, muscle wasting, poor growth in children
Visible_Nail_Signs: Thin nail plate prone to breakage, reduced nail growth rate
Common_Systemic_Symptoms: Muscle wasting, edema, growth retardation, lethargy, immune suppression
Risk_Factors: Severe caloric/protein restriction, chronic illness, poverty, eating disorders

Key_Symptoms: Soft, pliable nails that bend easily, fatigue, poor skin condition
Visible_Nail_Signs: Softened nail plate lacking normal rigidity, easily deformed with light pressure
Common_Systemic_Symptoms: Weight loss, muscle wasting, weakness, delayed development in children
Risk_Factors: Chronic undernutrition, restrictive diets, malabsorption, poverty

Key_Symptoms: Rough ridged nail texture, fatigue, poor growth
Visible_Nail_Signs: Horizontal (Beau's lines) or longitudinal ridging reflecting episodes of nutritional stress during nail growth
Common_Systemic_Symptoms: Growth arrest lines, generalized weakness, poor wound healing, edema in severe cases
Risk_Factors: Chronic or episodic severe malnutrition, significant illness during nail growth period, poverty

Key_Symptoms: Nail discoloration, thickening, pain, separation from nail bed
Visible_Nail_Signs: Pitting of nail plate, oil-drop/salmon patch discoloration, onycholysis (nail separation), subungual hyperkeratosis
Common_Systemic_Symptoms: Joint pain (psoriatic arthritis), skin plaques elsewhere on body
Risk_Factors: Genetic predisposition, immune dysregulation, stress, skin trauma (Koebner phenomenon)

Key_Symptoms: Thickened, discolored nails, brittleness, mild discomfort
Visible_Nail_Signs: Yellow-brown discoloration, thickened and crumbly nail plate, subungual debris accumulation
Common_Systemic_Symptoms: Generally localized to nails/feet; may coexist with athlete's foot (tinea pedis)
Risk_Factors: Diabetes, poor circulation, communal shower/pool use, nail trauma, immunosuppression, older age

Key_Symptoms: Pain, nail discoloration (bruising), possible nail loss after injury
Visible_Nail_Signs: Subungual hematoma (dark red/purple discoloration beneath nail), nail plate cracking or detachment
Common_Systemic_Symptoms: Generally localized to the injury site; no systemic symptoms unless infection develops
Risk_Factors: Recent physical injury, repetitive mechanical stress, tight footwear, occupational hazards

Key_Symptoms: Nail thinning, longitudinal ridging, pain, possible nail loss
Visible_Nail_Signs: Thinning and longitudinal ridging of nail plate, pterygium formation (scarring fusion of proximal nail fold to nail bed), potential permanent nail loss in severe cases
Common_Systemic_Symptoms: May be associated with lichen planus lesions on skin (violaceous papules) or in mouth (oral lichen planus)
Risk_Factors: Autoimmune predisposition, hepatitis C association in some cases, certain medications, stress

Key_Symptoms: Redness, swelling, tenderness around nail fold, possible pus discharge
Visible_Nail_Signs: Acutely inflamed, swollen, tender periungual skin, possible abscess/pus formation, nail plate discoloration in chronic cases
Common_Systemic_Symptoms: Fever in severe bacterial cases; generally localized symptoms
Risk_Factors: Frequent hand-in-water exposure, nail biting, manicure trauma, diabetes, immunosuppression
